decisions.reason: The marine box cooler line has shown evidence of strong market share, so the option has largely paid off and deserves continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line and costs little to keep, though there has been no visibility since 2018 and its value remains uncertain.
Finned tubes are a low-cost component that supports the air cooler business, so keeping this option open stays cheap and strategically useful.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes support efficiency and sustainability improvements across the portfolio at low marginal cost, which justifies keeping the option alive.
